work: Questions About The Mourning For Three Years
heading: Liji 35 · San Nian Wen 三年問 · Questions About The Mourning For Three Years · San Nian Wen 1 … San Nian Wen 14

items.text: Mourn your deceased parent for three years with the appointed forms (sackcloth with jagged edges, dark sackcloth, staff, shed, gruel, sleeping on straw, earthen pillow) to express the extremity of grief.
items.quote: The mourning of three years, being appointed with its various forms in harmony with the feelings (produced by the occasion of it), was intended to mark the greatest degree of grief.

items.text: End the mourning for your deceased parent at the close of the twenty-fifth month, and then resume your duties toward the living.
items.quote: there should be an end to the duties rendered to the dead, and that the time was come for the resumption of their duties to the living

items.text: Mourn deceased relatives according to the appointed grades: one year for the nearest kindred, nine months and shorter periods for more distant kin, as the ancient kings determined.
items.quote: Therefore the ancient kings determined the proper medium for mourning, and appointed its definite terms.
